tools.name: find_best
tools.description: Call this when a task needs an outside API or data source and you have not picked one, e.g. "search the web", "scrape this page to markdown", "get the BTC price", "Instagram comments for a post", "flight prices", "generate a PDF", "solve a captcha", "translate this text". Returns the recommended pay

tools.name: compare_category
tools.description: Call this to weigh the options in one area instead of taking find_best's single recommendation, or when the user asks "which is the cheapest / most reliable X API?". Returns every tracked API in the category ranked by score, with price per call, reliability, usage and any warnings. Category ids: web

tools.name: most_popular
tools.description: Call this when the user asks what other people use, or wants a safe, proven choice: the 3 APIs in a category with the most paying users in the last 30 days, "Most popular" first. APIs with warnings are held back and named. Category ids: web-search, web-extraction, llm-inference, crypto-prices, oncha

tools.name: check_endpoint
tools.description: Call this before paying a specific API URL you were given or found elsewhere, to see whether it can be trusted: Hagglyai's reliability score and recent check history, its price per call, how many paying users it has, and any warnings (for example a payment wallet that does not match the seller). tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Call this to see whether Hagglyai can help with a need, or to get ids for compare_category and most_popular: every category with how many APIs it tracks, the cheapest price per call, and its platform and task sub-categories (e.g. instagram, comments).

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: find_best, check_endpoint, list_categories · Private data: check_endpoint · Public sink: find_best.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: find_best, check_endpoint, list_categories · Private data: check_endpoint · Public sink: find_best

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "find_best" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
